stories.headline: Nairobi will hold the first world athletics championships in Africa
stories.summary: World Athletics has awarded the 2029 World Athletics Championships to Nairobi, Kenya. It will be the twenty-second edition, and the first time the event is held in Africa. Munich, Germany, takes the 2031 championships.

stories.headline: Asian Games athletes will sleep on a cruise ship
stories.summary: The 2026 Asian Games are being held from 19 September to 4 October around Aichi Prefecture in Japan. Around 4,000 to 5,000 athletes will be housed on the Costa Serena, a cruise ship docked at Kinjo Pier. Nagoya is the third Japanese city to host the Games, after Tokyo in 1958 and Hiroshima in 1994.

stories.headline: Chile is the first in South America to end dog-borne rabies
stories.summary: Chile has become the first country in South America to eliminate rabies transmitted by dogs. The World Health Organization has confirmed the milestone.

stories.headline: A tooth in a Californian creek turns out to be a mastodon's
stories.summary: Brigid Lynch, a geomorphologist at Balance Hydrologics, spotted something in a creek in California's San Mateo County and thought it could be from an animal. It was an intact fossil molar from an adult Pacific mastodon, Mammut pacificus. The animals lived until about 11,700 years ago.
